schema_findings.issue: Full name field concatenates the name with professional title and full contact line rather than only the person's name
Employer-level entry for Arcesium has empty role; role text is elsewhere, but source shows Arcesium block also carries the Senior Analyst title line
Company name is populated from fragments of responsibility bullets (go-live text and ETL sentence) instead of an employer name in source
Senior Analyst role split into a separate entry with invented company text; source places this role under Arcesium India (experience[0])
Only a subset of responsibilities captured (5 of ~14 bullets); bullets on trade lifecycle, investor flow, audit liaison and others omitted
Analyst – Trade Accounting & Data Operations entry lacks company and dates; source places it within the Arcesium block (Dec 2022 – Dec 2024)
Only 2 of 5 Analyst bullets captured; SSIs/SWIFT, corporate actions and NAV/financial statements bullets omitted
Intercontinental Exchange (ICE)/NYSE Data Researcher role (Nov 2021 – Nov 2022) entirely omitted from experience array
Location is null although source employer line explicitly states Hyderabad
Employer-level entry has no responsibilities and no technologies, dropping all Arcesium duty text
4.0 years stated in summary, but source history spans Nov 2021 to Present (~3+ years), and education MBA ran 2020–2022 overlapping employment; figure not reconcilable from source
Summary contains verbatim typo 'Buikt ETL workflows' and trailing fragment 'Big Four mid- and year-end audit engagements.'; extraction did not flag garbled text
Degree field concatenates degree and dates ('MBA – Finance & Data Analytics2020 – 2022'); dates not split into start/graduation year
Institution field merges university, city and coursework line, including a trailing dangling 'Portfolio Management,' fragment
Field of study null although source course content (Derivatives, Portfolio Management, Financial Modelling, Data Analytics) implies a finance/data field
Degree field concatenates degree and dates ('B.Com (Commerce)2017 – 2020'); start/graduation years null
Academic years present in source (MBA 2020–2022, B.Com 2017–2020) not mapped to start_year for either record
Single certification entry concatenates all four credentials plus the section header '& CERTIFICATIONS'; should be separate records
Certification issuer text '— NSE Academy', 'Quantbot Securities Pvt. Ltd.' embedded in name rather than issuer field; issuer null
Tools list mixes platforms with 'Advanced MS Excel'/'Advanced Excel' duplicates and 'Bloomberg'/'Bloomberg (Basic)' duplicates from overlapping source lines
Technical skills limited to Python and SQL; source also lists Power BI in the same technical line but is classified only as tool, and 'Ai tools' omitted
All-skills array contains broken fragments from line-split competencies (e.g. 'Geneva Accounting Engine (NAV', '& Config)', '(Quarterly/Annual)', '(Mid/Year-End)') rather than atomic skills
Soft skills array empty; source mentions cross-functional collaboration and training/mentoring indicators
Domain skills only 3 entries; source lists many domain competencies (NAV, prime brokerage, FX operations, onboarding, audit management) not represented
Arcesium 2025 Spot Award present in source but no awards field exists in output data; achievement dropped

section_review.message: DeepSeek returned incomplete or invalid placements. No partial changes were applied.

schema_findings.issue: full_name includes the professional headline and contact line concatenated with the name, not just the candidate's name
location is recorded as 'Hyderabad' but source text states 'Hyderabad, India'
summary text contains verbatim typo 'Buikt ETL workflows' and truncated fragment 'mid- and year-end audit engagements' with no verb preceding it; presented as clean narrative
4.0 years appears derived from summary phrase '4+ years'; source also lists ICE/NYSE Nov 2021–Nov 2022 which would raise total tenure beyond 4 years

Arcesium entry has an empty role while source shows the employer line followed by two distinct role/date lines (Senior Analyst Jan 2025–Present and Analyst Dec 2022–Dec 2024); the roles were split into separate experience entries rather than under the employer
responsibilities array is empty although source lists numerous duties under the Arcesium employer entry

company field contains concatenated source fragments ('ensure seamless go-live across systems...', 'projects, contributing operational expertise...', 'Built ETL workflows in Python...') that are bullet text, not an employer name

responsibilities are only partial sentence fragments with dangling trailing commas/commas, and several source bullets (e.g., summar stated 'Played a key role in launching two new funds ($4B and $120B AUM)' e26, e35 audit liaison, e28 investor flows) are not reflected

experience[2] has empty company; source shows the Analyst role belongs to Arcesium (employer line precedes it) but no employer was established, and ICE/NYSE employer (e44) is entirely absent from the experience array
Analyst role start/end dates (Dec 2022–Dec 2024) present in source were not captured; start_date, end_date, duration all null
ICE/NYSE Data Researcher I (Nov 2021–Nov 2022) employment with its responsibilities is missing from the experience array
all experience location values are null though source lines include Hyderabad for both Arcesium and ICE/NYSE
degree field contains dates glued to degree text: 'MBA – Finance & Data Analytics2020 – 2022'
institution field contains coursework text appended: 'Prestige Institute of Management & Research, Indore | Relevant coursework: Derivatives, Portfolio Management,'
start_year is null while source shows 2020–2022 range
degree field contains dates glued to degree text: 'B.Com (Commerce)2017 – 2020'
graduation_year is null while source shows 2017–2020 range

certification name bundles the section heading '& CERTIFICATIONS' and all four distinct certifications (NSE Academy PGP, NISM Series-VII, Series-XV, Quantbot) into a single string instead of separate items
issuer is null despite named issuing bodies (NSE Academy, NISM, Quantbot Securities) present in source

skills list contains broken line-fragment tokens ('Geneva Accounting Engine (NAV', '& Config)', 'Prime Broker & Custodian', 'Reconciliation', 'Middle Office & Post-Trade', 'Operations', 'P&L calculations and', 'valuations', etc.) that split single core competencies across array entries
source contains Arcesium 2025 Spot Award achievement but no awards field exists in the schema data output
